However, there was a minor compliance issue as the agent did imply it was unable to provide the discount requested (10% waiver); stating it would relay the request affects negotiations. There were no mentions of threats of legal action or consequences.

The customer inquired about a possible 10% adjustment on the second invoice SL/26-27/0003 but was informed that this was not possible. Next, the accounts team will monitor for the promised payment on the first invoice and address the request regarding the second invoice adjustment.
